title: Cloudflare Just Blocked AI Bots on 20% of the Internet
description:
1 in 5 websites on the internet run through Cloudflare, and as of Sept 15 it blocks AI training and agent bots by default on monetized pages 🔥

They now sort bots into three buckets: search, agent, and training. Search still gets through. Even free plan owners get the toggle ✨

Years of quiet scraping just hit a wall across 20% of the web 😅

#ai #chatgpt #claude #claudecode #gemini
